style="width:0.1%"></td></tr><tr style="height:3pt"><td colspan="3" style="border-bottom:1pt solid #000;padding:0 1pt"></td></tr></table></div><div style="margin-top:3pt;padding-left:18pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:7pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(1)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Net interest income plus non-interest income, less non-interest expense.</font></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:7pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(2)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;These adjusted measures are non-GAAP measures. Please refer to &#8220;GAAP to Non-GAAP Reconciliations&#8221; for the computations of these adjusted measures and the reconciliation of these non-GAAP measures to the most directly comparable GAAP measure.</font></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:7pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(3)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Non-interest expense divided by the sum of net interest income and non-interest income.</font></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:7pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(4)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Stockholders&#8217; equity excluding preferred stock, less goodwill and intangibles, divided by shares outstanding at period end.</font></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:7pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(5)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Includes service charges on deposit accounts, wealth management and trust fee income, investment banking and advisory fees and trading income.</font></div><div style="height:13.5pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div></div><div id="i0ecb4ad38568429a8c0f7ba8cf71c125_4"></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:22.5pt;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:5pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">THIRD QUARTER 2026 COMPARED TO SECOND QUARTER 2026</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">For the third quarter of 2026, Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) reported net income available to common stockholders of $99.4 million, or $2.28 per diluted share, compared to $80.6 million, or $1.83 per diluted share, for the second quarter of 2026.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Provision for credit losses for the third quarter of 2026 was $17.0 million, compared to $18.0 million for the second quarter of 2026. The $17.0 million provision for credit losses recorded in the third quarter of 2026 resulted primarily from an increase in criticized loans and $14.5 million in net charge-offs.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Net interest income increased to $275.0 million for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $260.4 million for the second quarter of 2026, primarily due to an increase in average earning asset yields and decreases in short-term and long-term borrowings, partially offset by an increase in funding costs. Net interest margin for the third quarter of 2026 was 3.44%, an increase of 16 basis points from the second quarter of 2026. Loans held for investment (&#8220;LHI&#8221;), excluding mortgage finance, yields increased 14 basis points from the second quarter of 2026 and LHI, mortgage finance, yields increased 10 basis points from the second quarter of 2026. Total cost of deposits was 2.45% for the third quarter of 2026, a 5 basis point increase from the second quarter of 2026.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Non-interest income for the third quarter of 2026 increased $6.5 million compared to the second quarter of 2026 primarily due to increases in investment banking and advisory fees and other non-interest income.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Non-interest expense for the third quarter of 2026 decreased $1.6 million compared to the second quarter of 2026, primarily due to decreases in salaries and benefits, legal and professional and other non-interest expense, partially offset by an increase in communications and technology expense primarily resulting from restructuring expenses recognized in the third quarter of 2026.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">THIRD QUARTER 2026 COMPARED TO THIRD QUARTER 2025</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Net income available to common stockholders was $99.4 million, or $2.28 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $100.9 million, or $2.18 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2025.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The third quarter of 2026 included a $17.0 million provision for credit losses, reflecting a linked-quarter increase in criticized loans and $14.5 million in net charge-offs, compared to a $12.0 million provision for credit losses for the third quarter of 2025.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Net interest income increased to $275.0 million for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $271.8 million for the third quarter of 2025, primarily due to an increase in average earning assets and a decrease in funding costs, partially offset by a decrease in earning asset yields and an increase in average interest bearing deposits. Net interest margin decreased 3 basis points to 3.44% for the third quarter of 2026, as compared to the third quarter of 2025. LHI, excluding mortgage finance, yields decreased 19 basis points compared to the third quarter of 2025 and LHI, mortgage finance yields decreased 16 basis points from the third quarter of 2025. Total cost of deposits decreased 17 basis points to 2.45%, as compared to the third quarter of 2025.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Non-interest income for the third quarter of 2026 increased $13.1 million compared to the third quarter of 2025 primarily due to increases in service charges on deposit accounts, investment banking and advisory fees, trading income and other non-interest income.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Non-interest expense for the third quarter of 2026 increased $13.3 million compared to the third quarter of 2025, primarily due to increases in salaries and benefits, occupancy and communications and technology expense, primarily as a result of the restructuring expenses discussed above, as well as an increase in other non-interest expense.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:5pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">CREDIT QUALITY</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Net charge-offs of $14.5 million were recorded during the third quarter of 2026, compared to net charge-offs of $16.1 million and $13.7 million during the second quarter of 2026 and the third quarter of 2025, respectively. Criticized loans totaled $782.4 million at September&#160;30, 2026, compared to $696.3 million at June 30, 2026 and $529.7 million at September&#160;30, 2025. Non-accrual LHI totaled $122.3 million at September&#160;30, 2026, compared to $124.0 million at June 30, 2026 and $96.1 million at September&#160;30, 2025. The ratio of non-accrual LHI to total LHI for the third quarter of 2026 was 0.51%, compared to 0.50% for the second quarter of 2026 and 0.40% for the third quarter of 2025. The ratio of total allowance for credit losses to total LHI was 1.39% at September&#160;30, 2026, compared to 1.34% and 1.37% at June 30, 2026 and September&#160;30, 2025, respectively.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:5pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">REGULATORY RATIOS AND CAPITAL</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">All regulatory ratios continue to be in excess of &#8220;well capitalized&#8221; requirements as of September&#160;30, 2026. CET1, tier 1 capital, total capital and leverage ratios were 12.2%, 13.7%, 14.8% and 11.7%, respectively, at September&#160;30, 2026, compared to 12.1%, 13.5%, 14.7% and 11.6%, respectively, at June 30, 2026 and 12.1%, 13.6%, 16.1% and 11.9%, respectively, at September&#160;30, 2025. At September&#160;30, 2026, the Company&#8217;s ratio of tangible common equity to total tangible assets was 9.9%, compared to 9.9% at June 30, 2026 and 10.3% at September&#160;30, 2025.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">During the third quarter of 2026, the Company repurchased 1,051,660 shares of its common stock for an aggregate purchase price, including excise tax expense, of $103.0 million, at a weighted average price of $96.99 per share.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Effective October 20, 2026, the Company&#8217;s board of directors authorized a new share repurchase program under which the Company may repurchase up to $200.0 million in shares of its outstanding common stock through October 31, 2027. Remaining repurchase authorization under the December 12, 2025 share repurchase program was terminated upon authorization of this new program.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">PREFERRED AND COMMON DIVIDENDS</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">The Company&#8217;s board of directors declared a cash dividend of $14.375 per share of the 5.75% Fixed Rate Non-Cumulative Perpetual </font></div><div style="height:22.5pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">2</font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:22.5pt;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Preferred Stock, Series B (the &#8220;Series B Preferred Stock&#8221;), equivalent to $0.359375 per depositary share, each representing a 1&#47;40th interest in a share of the Series B Preferred Stock. The depositary shares are traded on the Texas Stock Exchange LLC (&#8220;TXSE&#8221;) under the symbol &#8220;TCBI PRB.&#8221; The dividend is payable on December&#160;15, 2026, to holders of record at the close of business on December&#160;1, 2026.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">The Company&#8217;s board of directors declared a cash dividend of $0.20 per common share. The common shares are traded on the TXSE under the symbol &#8220;TCBI.&#8221; The dividend is payable on December&#160;15, 2026, to holders of record at the close of business on December&#160;1, 2026.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">About Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc. (TXSE&#174;&#58; TCBI), a member of the Russell 2000&#174; Index and the S&#38;P MidCap 400&#174;, is the parent company of Texas Capital Bank (&#8220;TCB&#8221;). Texas Capital is the collective brand name for TCB and its separate, non-bank affiliates and wholly owned subsidiaries. Texas Capital is a full-service financial services firm that delivers customized solutions to businesses, entrepreneurs and individual customers. Founded in 1998, the institution is headquartered in Dallas with offices in Austin, Houston, San Antonio and Fort Worth, and has built a network of clients across the country. With the ability to service clients through their entire lifecycles, Texas Capital has established commercial banking, consumer banking, investment banking and wealth management capabilities. All services are subject to applicable laws, regulations and service terms. Deposit and lending products and services are offered by TCB. For deposit products, member FDIC. For more information, please visit www.texascapital.com.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Forward-Looking Statements</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">This communication contains &#8220;forward-looking statements&#8221; within the meaning of and pursuant to the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995 regarding, among other things, TCBI&#8217;s financial condition, results of operations, business plans and future performance.
